description: EXPOsan collects sanitation and resource-recovery system models built with QSDsan. The maintained package supplies individual system modules, loading instructions and example outputs. This resource is provided by QSD-Group (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: NCSA. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The current README requires Python 3.12 or newer, and some features need optional dependencies. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-qsdsan-quantitative-sustainable-design-sanitation. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
